title: 浣溪沙（细雨斜风作晓寒）
titleEn: Washing Silk in the Stream (Fine Rain and Slanting Wind)
author: 苏轼
intro: A winter outing near the Huai River ends with a cup of frothy tea and a plate of fresh spring greens — and a line every Chinese food lover knows: the real flavour of life is simple joy.
analysis: 这首词写苏轼和朋友冬末去南山游玩。上阕写景：清晨下着细雨，吹着斜风，有点冷；不久天晴了，淡淡的烟雾、稀疏的柳树，让河滩显得格外可爱（“媚”）；清澈的洛涧流进淮河，水面越来越宽广。下阕写吃：中午喝一杯茶，茶面上浮着雪白的泡沫；再尝一盘春天的野菜——蓼菜的嫩芽、蒿笋。最后一句是千古名句：“人间有味是清欢”——人世间真正有滋味的，是这种清淡的快乐。清欢，就是简单、不奢华、让人心里干净的快乐。苏轼刚经历了多年的贬谪，却能从一杯茶、一盘野菜里感受到幸福，这正是他豁达的人生态度。
analysisEn: Su Shi wrote this after an outing to South Mountain with a friend at the end of winter. The first stanza is landscape: a dawn of fine rain and slanting wind, a little cold; then it clears, and thin mist and sparse willows make the river beach look charming. The clear Luo stream flows into the Huai River, and the water spreads wider and wider. The second stanza is food. At noon they drink tea, its surface covered in snow-white froth, and taste a “spring plate” of fresh wild greens — tender knotweed shoots and wormwood stems. Then comes one of Su Shi’s most quoted lines: 人间有味是清欢 — “what truly has flavour in this world is simple joy.” 清欢 is a light, uncomplicated happiness with nothing showy about it. After years of exile, Su Shi could still find real happiness in a cup of tea and a plate of greens. That is his attitude to life in a single line.
background: Su Shi (1037–1101) wrote this on the 24th day of the 12th lunar month of 1084, just after leaving his exile at Huangzhou for a new post. Near Sizhou (by the Huai River) he went walking on South Mountain with a local friend, Liu Qianshu.
pronunciation: 斜风 xié（旧读 xiá，今按 xié）；漫漫 màn màn；蓼茸 liǎo róng（蓼：一种水边野菜）；蒿笋 hāo sǔn；午盏 wǔ zhǎn。“蓼”机器朗读可能读错，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行文本。原词有小序：“元丰七年十二月二十四日，从泗州刘倩叔游南山。”（维基文库所据本作“十月二十四日”）网站正文不收小序。

lines.py: xì yǔ xié fēng zuò xiǎo hán
lines.lit: Fine rain and slanting wind make the dawn cold;
lines.en: Fine rain and a slanting wind bring a chill to the dawn;

lines.py: dàn yān shū liǔ mèi qíng tān
lines.lit: pale mist and sparse willows charm the sunny shore.
lines.en: then thin mist and sparse willows make the bright shore lovely.

lines.py: rù huái qīng luò jiàn màn màn
lines.lit: The clear Luo, entering the Huai, gradually spreads wide.
lines.en: The clear Luo pours into the Huai, wider and wider.

lines.py: xuě mò rǔ huā fú wǔ zhǎn
lines.lit: Snow-froth and milk-blossoms float in the noon cup;
lines.en: Froth white as snow and milk floats on our noon tea;

lines.py: liǎo róng hāo sǔn shì chūn pán
lines.lit: knotweed shoots and wormwood stems — we try the spring plate.
lines.en: we taste a spring plate of tender shoots and greens.

lines.py: rén jiān yǒu wèi shì qīng huān
lines.lit: In the human world, what has flavour is pure joy.
lines.en: What gives this world its true flavour is simple joy.

words.note: “斜风细雨”今天仍是常用词语。
滩：河边的沙地，现代汉语“沙滩”“海滩”。
淮河，今天仍是中国的重要河流。
这里指流入淮河的洛涧，不是洛阳的洛水。
宋代流行“点茶”，把茶粉打出白沫。
今天多用作量词，如“一盏灯”。
茸：初生的嫩芽，现代汉语“毛茸茸”。

words.en: a plate of fresh spring vegetables
words.note: 古代立春前后吃新鲜蔬菜的习俗，今天“春饼”“春卷”和它有关。
因这首词成为常用的书面语。

imagery.name: 雨
imagery.zh: 清晨的细雨斜风带来寒意，随后转晴，写出天气和心情由冷到暖的变化。
imagery.en: The fine morning rain brings a chill, then clears — the weather, like his mood, turns from cold to warm.

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 冬末的柳树还很稀疏，在淡淡的烟雾中却已有了早春的妩媚。
imagery.en: At winter’s end the willows are still sparse, yet in the thin mist they already hint at early spring.
